data.long_meaning: Rupa means 'form', 'shape', 'appearance', 'beauty', 'wealth', or 'prosperity'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rup' meaning 'form'. In Hinduism, Rupa is considered a divine name and is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who represents wealth and prosperity. The name Rupa carries the meaning “Form, Beauty, Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rupa usually hope their child will grow to embody form, beauty, wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rupa is a spiritual name that represents the divine form of the universe and the inner beauty of an individual. It is a reminder to see the beauty in all things and to cultivate inner radiance and joy.
data.etymology: Rupa belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Form, Beauty, Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rupa total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
